title: What are the challenges facing the Mecca agreement?
english: Saudi Arabia has entered into a new defense alliance with Turkey and Pakistan to broaden its military partnerships beyond its traditional reliance on the United States. This agreement comes amid rising regional tensions involving the Houthis in Yemen and ongoing diplomatic uncertainty regarding Iran. Experts are now debating whether this trilateral pact can serve as a functional replacement for the security protection previously guaranteed by Washington.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የነበራትን የረዥም ጊዜ ወታደራዊ ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ በማሰብ ከቱርክ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርማለች። ይህ ስምምነት በየመን ሁቲዎች እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው የክልሉ አለመረጋጋት ወቅት የመጣ ነው። ተንታኞች ይህ አዲስ ጥምረት ዋሽንግተን ትሰጠው የነበረውን የደህንነት ዋስትና በአማራጭነት ሊተካ ይችላል ወይ የሚለውን ጥያቄ እያነሱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan hirkattummaa ishee kan yeroo dheeraa kan Ameerikaa irratti qabdu hir'isuuf, biyyoota Turkey fi Paakistaan wajjin waliigaltee ittisa haaraa mallatteessiteetti. Waliigalteen kun yeroo humnoonni Huutii Yemen keessatti fi hariiroon Iran wajjin walxaxaa ta'eetti kan dhufedha. Hayyoonni gamtaan kun gargaarsa nageenyaa duraan Waashingtan irraa argamaa ture bakka bu'uu danda'a moo miti jedhanii gaaffii kaasuutti jiru.

title: Three Palestinians killed and dozens wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza and West Bank
english: Israeli military operations and settler attacks across Gaza and the West Bank have resulted in the deaths of three Palestinians and dozens of injuries. In the West Bank, forces raided multiple cities and towns, using tear gas and live fire, while settlers assaulted residents and damaged private property. Additionally, military actions in northern Gaza led to further casualties, contributing to the rising death toll since the ongoing conflict began.
amharic: በጋዛ እና በምዕራብ ባንክ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። በምዕራብ ባንክ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተለያዩ ከተሞች በመግባት እንባ አስነዋሪ ጋዝ እና ጥይቶችን በመጠቀም ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን ሲያጠቁ፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ሰፋሪዎች በዜጎች ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። በሰሜን ጋዛ በተካሄደው ተመሳሳይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃም የሰው ህይወት የጠፋ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ቀደም ሲል ከተጀመረው ግጭት ወዲህ የሟቾችን ቁጥር ከፍ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hojiin waraanaa Israa'el fi weerarri warra biyya lafaa qabatanii jiran Gaza fi Lixaa Baankii keessatti namoota Falasxiin sadii ajjeesee, namoota hedduu ammoo mii'eessera. Lixaa Baankii keessatti waraanni magaaloowwan hedduu weeraruun gaazii imimmaansuu fi rasaasaan namoota irratti tarkaanfii fudhateera, akkasumas warri biyya qabatanii jiran jiraattota miidhuun qabeenya isaanii mancaasaniiru. Gamtaan Gaza kaabaa keessatti tarkaanfiin waraanaa fudhatame lubbuu namaa kan galaafate yoo ta'u, kunis walitti bu'iinsa kanaan dura jalqabame irraa eegalee lakkoofsa namoota du'anii daran dabaleera.

title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
english: Oman is mediating talks with Iran regarding the reopening of the vital Strait of Hormuz, which has been blockaded following recent regional conflicts. While officials acknowledge progress in the negotiations, Iran maintains that a full restoration of shipping traffic is conditional on the U.S. meeting specific demands. These requirements include releasing frozen assets and stopping naval blockades, leaving the timeline for any final agreement uncertain.
amharic: ኦማን በቅርቡ በተፈጠሩ የክልል ግጭቶች ምክንያት የተዘጋውን ወሳኝ የሆነውን የሆርሙዝ የባህር መስመር ለመክፈት ከኢራን ጋር በመወያየት ላይ ትገኛለች። ምንም እንኳን የሁለቱም ወገኖች ንግግሮች በመሻሻል ላይ ቢሆኑም፣ ኢራን የመርከብ እንቅስቃሴው ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቀጥል አሜሪካ በረዶ የሆኑ ሀብቶቿን እንድትለቅ እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎችን እንድታነሳ ጨምሮ የተወሰኑ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን አስቀምጣለች። በመሆኑም ስምምነቱ የሚጠናቀቅበት ጊዜ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Omaan daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz kan yeroo dhihoo as rakkoo naannichaa hordofee cufame deebisanii banuuf mootummaa Iraan waliin mari'achaa jirti. Mariin kun abdii kan qabu ta'us, Iraan immoo daandichi guututti akka banamuuf Ameerikaan qabeenya ishee qabame gadhiisuu fi uggura galaana irraa kaasuun dirqama akka ta'e himti. Kanaafuu, mariin kun hanga yoomitti akka xumuramu fi daandichi yoom akka banamu ifa miti.

title: At least 200 people evacuated as wildfire rages near Lake Garda
english: A wildfire has erupted near Lake Garda in Italy, forcing the emergency evacuation of at least 200 people. The blaze began in the Tignale area, located on the lake's western shore. Authorities are working to manage the situation in this popular tourist region.
amharic: በጣሊያን ጋርዳ ሐይቅ አቅራቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ምክንያት ቢያንስ 200 ሰዎች ከአካባቢው ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተደርገዋል። እሳቱ የተነሳው በሐይቁ ምዕራባዊ ክፍል በሚገኘው ቲኛሌ በተባለች ከተማ ነው። ባለስልጣናት በቱሪስቶች ዘንድ ተወዳጅ በሆነው በዚህ አካባቢ የተቀሰቀሰውን እሳት ለመቆጣጠር ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Itaaliyaatti, ziqqoo haroo Gaardaatti ibidda hammaataa ka'een walqabatee namoonni 200 ol ta'an naannichaa gadhiisanii akka bahan dirqamaniru. Ibidni kun kan jalqabe kutaalee lixaa haroo sanaa kan taate magaalattii Tiiniyaale keessatti. Aangoonni mootummaa naannoo tuuristoonni baay'inaan itti walgahanii kan ta'e kana keessatti ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Lebanese soldiers injured while Israeli troops intrude on southern town
english: Three Lebanese soldiers were injured while clearing unexploded explosives in the village of Zawtar al-Gharbiyah. This incident occurred shortly after reports that Israeli forces had entered the area and constructed an earthen barrier, which local officials described as a violation of a recent security agreement. While the Israeli military claims it has no knowledge of the event, the village is a key pilot zone designated for the return of displaced residents under a US-backed peace framework.
amharic: በዛውታር አል-ጋርቢያ መንደር ያልፈነዱ ፈንጂዎችን በማፅዳት ላይ የነበሩ ሶስት የሊባኖስ ወታደሮች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ የተፈጠረው የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ወደ አካባቢው በመግባት የመሬት መከላከያ ግንባታ ማካሄዳቸውን ተከትሎ ሲሆን፣ የሀገር ውስጥ ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱን የቅርብ ጊዜ የፀጥታ ስምምነት ጥሰት ነው ብለውታል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ክፍል ስለ ጉዳዩ እንደማያውቅ ቢገልጽም፣ መንደሯ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ በተደረገ የሰላም ስምምነት መሰረት ተፈናቃዮች ወደ ቀያቸው እንዲመለሱ ከተመረጡት ቁልፍ አካባቢዎች አንዷ ናት።
oromo: Godina Zawtar al-Gharbiyah keessatti loltoonni Libanoos sadii otoo meeshaa waraanaa hin dhoonye of irraa kaasaa jiranuu miidhaan irra gaheera. Kunis kan ta'e erga waraanni Israa'el ganda kana keessa seenee daangaa lafaa ijaaree booda; hoggantoonni naannichaa gocha kana caba waliigaltee nageenyaa isaan jedhaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el waa'ee taatee kanaa akka hin beekne ibsatees, gandi kun waliigaltee Ameerikaan deggeramee fi uummati buqqa'e itti deebi'uuf karoorfame keessaa bakka ijoo dha.

title: US slams Chinese ‘nature reserve’ as effort to claim South China Sea
english: The United States has condemned China for labeling the Scarborough Reef a 'nature reserve,' describing it as a deceptive tactic to block Filipino fishermen from their traditional waters. The U.S. stated that Beijing is using environmental excuses to reinforce its illegal territorial claims in the South China Sea. Washington reaffirmed its support for the Philippines, emphasizing the importance of maintaining an open and peaceful Indo-Pacific region.
amharic: አሜሪካ ቻይና ስካርቦሮ ሪፍ የተባለውን አካባቢ 'የተፈጥሮ መጠለያ' በማለት መሰየሟን ተቃውማለች። ይህ ድርጊት የፊሊፒንስ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ወደ ባህላዊ የዓሣ ማጥመጃ ቦታቸው እንዳይገቡ ለመከልከል የተደረገ የማታለያ ስልት መሆኑን አሜሪካ ገልጻለች። በደቡብ ቻይና ባህር ላይ የራሷን የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ለማስከበር ቻይና የአካባቢ ጥበቃን እንደ ሽፋን እየተጠቀመች እንደሆነ የገለጸችው አሜሪካ፣ ከፊሊፒንስ ጎን መሆኗን አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Amerikaa Itoophiyaa kan taate Chaayinaan naannoo iskaarborooriif jedhamu 'bakka eegumsa uumamaa' jechuun moggaasuushee balaaleffatteetti. Gochi kun qaqqabamummaa qurxummii qabattoota Filippiins kan daangessuufi lafa bishaanichaa harka ishee galchuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu Ameerikaan beeksisteetti. Chaayinaan aangoo ishee babal'isuuf sababa qilleensaafi naannoo fayyadamuu ishee kan mormite Ameerikaan, mootummaa Filippiins cinaa akka dhaabbattu mirkaneessiteetti.

title: ‘Debilitating’: Hunter Biden speaks out about father Joe Biden’s cancer
english: Hunter Biden recently shared that his father, former President Joe Biden, is suffering from painful, advanced prostate cancer that has spread to his bones. During a television interview, the younger Biden expressed deep sadness over his father's deteriorating health condition. Joe Biden was diagnosed with the aggressive illness in May 2025, several months after he decided to withdraw from the 2024 presidential election following concerns about his health and performance.

title: Yemen’s government forces attack Houthis amid renewed shelling of Marib
english: Yemeni government forces have launched a retaliatory offensive against Houthi positions following a series of deadly missile and drone attacks on Marib and Hadramout. This escalation, which follows the expiration of a long-standing truce, has caused significant civilian casualties and sparked fears of a return to full-scale civil war. Experts are warning that these renewed clashes indicate a dangerous shift toward broader instability in the region.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በማሪብ እና በሃድራሞት ከተሞች በሁቲዎች ላይ ከደረሰ ገዳይ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት በኋላ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ መውሰዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የረጅም ጊዜ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ካበቃ በኋላ የተከሰተው ይህ ግጭት ለብዙ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ሞትና መቁሰል ምክንያት ሆኗል። ባለሙያዎች አሁን እየታየ ያለው ውጥረት አገሪቱን ወደ ቀድሞው የርስ በርስ ጦርነት ሊመልሳት እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።

title: Turkey says Saudi-Pakistan defence pact mirrors NATO’s Article 5, Egypt could also join
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have formed a new defense alliance that functions like NATO's mutual defense clause, requiring members to support each other during threats. The agreement includes a specialized secretariat based in Saudi Arabia and a ministerial committee to manage strategic decisions. Officials have clarified that this pact is not directed at Iran and noted that Egypt may be invited to join the partnership in the future.

title: The influencers taking on far-right leader Nigel Farage
english: A group of social media influencers is actively challenging UK politician Nigel Farage by fact-checking his claims regarding immigration. These digital creators argue that traditional media outlets have been too lenient toward his far-right views. This movement follows Farage’s resignation as an MP, which was prompted by an investigation into his personal finances.

title: Gaza health chief urges action to ‘save’ Dr Abu Safia before it’s too late
english: Gaza’s health ministry chief is calling for immediate intervention to protect Dr. Hussam Abu Safia, who is being held by Israeli authorities. The pediatrician, who led Kamal Adwan Hospital, has reportedly suffered severe injuries due to torture and lacks essential medical attention in detention. Health officials and human rights groups are demanding his urgent release and immediate medical care, holding Israeli forces responsible for his deteriorating condition.

title: British Columbia issues evacuation orders ahead of fast-moving wildfires
english: British Columbia has declared a state of emergency as intense, out-of-control wildfires force thousands of residents to evacuate their homes. The fires have disrupted power and water services, causing significant damage in districts like Summerland. Officials continue to manage the crisis while scientists attribute the increased frequency and severity of these blazes to climate change and extreme heat.

title: Serbia and Ukraine pledge closer economic ties, eye free trade deal
english: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy have met in Belgrade to strengthen economic ties and finalize a long-delayed free trade deal by the end of the year. During the visit, Serbia pledged to assist in the reconstruction of Ukrainian cities and support Ukraine's integration into the European Union. While both nations maintained their respective positions on regional sovereignty issues, they agreed to increase cooperation on infrastructure and humanitarian aid.

title: Saudi-Pakistan-Turkiye pact: A new shield or strategic signal?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan have signed the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, a new pact where an attack on one nation is considered an attack on all three. Although officials state the treaty is not aimed at any specific country, analysts suggest it serves as a strategic move to deter regional threats amid the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran. The agreement combines Pakistan's manpower and Saudi funding with Turkiye's advanced military industry to bolster collective regional security.

title: US Vice President confirms direct US-Iran talks over Strait of Hormuz
english: US Vice President JD Vance has announced that the Trump administration is engaging in direct negotiations with Iran to ensure consistent oil and gas shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. While maintaining economic and military pressure on Tehran, officials are observing if the country will commit to significant long-term reforms. The primary goal of these efforts is to stabilize global energy supplies and lower fuel costs for the American public.

title: France shuts mosque over Quran verses and Islamic texts used in Muslim worship
english: A French court has upheld a six-month closure order for the Chanteloup mosque near Paris, ruling that the state's restrictions on religious teachings are lawful. Authorities targeted the mosque because imams referenced Quranic verses and traditional Islamic texts during their sermons. Legal representatives for the mosque argue that this decision infringes on religious freedom and plan to appeal the ruling to the Council of State.

oromo: Mana murtii Faransaay tokko masjiida 'Chanteloup' jedhamu kan Pariisitti argamu ji'a ja'aaf cufame akka turu murteesseera. Aangeyyonni mootummaa masjiida kana kan cufan, imaamonni lallaba isaanii keessatti keeyyatoota Qur'aanaa fi barreeffamoota Islaamaa aadaa ta'an fayyadamuu isaanii sababa godhataniiti. Gareen abukaattoota masjiidichaa murtoon kun bilisummaa amantii kan sarbu ta'uu ibsuun, gara mana murtii olaanaatti ol-iyyannoo galchuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68 after illness
english: Jorge Messi, the father and long-term agent of football star Lionel Messi, has passed away in his home city of Rosario at age 68 following a lengthy illness. He played a crucial role in his son's legendary career, supporting him from his early days at Newell's Old Boys to his global success with Barcelona and the Argentina national team. The football community, including his former clubs, has expressed condolences to the Messi family during this difficult time.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከቡ ሊዮኔል ሜሲ አባት እና የረጅም ጊዜ ወኪል የነበሩት ሆርሄ ሜሲ በ68 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። በልጃቸው የላቀ የስፖርት ጉዞ ላይ ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ የነበራቸው ሆርሄ፣ ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ እስካሁን ድረስ ባደረገው የሙያ ስኬት ጎን በመሆን ድጋፍ ያደርጉለት ነበር። የእግር ኳስ ቤተሰቡ እና የቀድሞ ክለቦቹ ለቤተሰቦቻቸው መጽናናትን ተመኝተዋል።
oromo: Abbaan fi bakka bu'aan taphataa kubbaa miillaa beekamaa Lionel Messi kan ta'an Jorge Messi dhukkuba booda umuriin isaanii waggaa 68 tti addunyaa kana irraa du'aan boqotaniiru. Jorge guddinaa fi milkaa'ina ilma isaanii keessatti gahee olaanaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, jalqaba irraa eegalee hanga injifannoo addunyaa irratti gargaarsa guddaa godhaniiru. Hawaasni kubbaa miillaa fi kilaboonni isaan dura itti taphatan maatii Messiif gadda isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Madonna pays tribute to 'genius, otherworldly' producer William Orbit
english: Madonna has shared a heartfelt tribute to her longtime collaborator, the Grammy-winning producer William Orbit, following his recent passing at age 69. She credited him for transforming her artistic direction, particularly during their iconic work on her acclaimed 1998 album, Ray of Light. Madonna described their studio sessions as a transformative and spiritual experience that helped her explore new creative depths.
amharic: ማዶና በ69 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት የተለዩትን የረጅም ጊዜ የሙዚቃ አጋሯንና አምራቹን ዊሊያም ኦርቢትን በማስታወስ ልብ የሚነካ መልዕክት አስተላልፋለች። የፖፕ ንግሥቲቱ በ1998 ዓ.ም 'ሬይ ኦፍ ላይት' የተሰኘውን የተሳካ አልበም በአንድነት በመስራት የሙዚቃ ህይወቷን እንደቀየሩት ገልጻለች። ማዶና ከኦርቢት ጋር በስቱዲዮ ውስጥ ያሳለፉትን ጊዜ እንደ መንፈሳዊ ጉዞ በመቁጠር፣ አብረው የሰሩት ስራ የፈጠራ ችሎታዋን እንዳሳደገው ገልጻለች።
oromo: Maadonnaan guddifachaa fi guddifachaa muuziqaa beekkamaa William Orbit, kan umuriin isaa 69 ta'e du'aan darbuusaa hordofee, yaadannoo cimaa isaa ibsiteetti. Isheenis, keessumaa bara 1998 albamii 'Ray of Light' jedhamu irratti waliin hojjechuun isaanii hojii ishee keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fiduusaa yaadatteetti. Maadonnaan yeroo isaan istuudiyoo keessatti dabarsan akka muuxannoo hafuuraa fi uumamaa guddaatti ilaaluun, obbolummaan isaanii dandeettii uumamaa ishee akka guddise ibsiteetti.

title: Which stars need to shine this season: Real Madrid, Barcelona, Man Utd, PSG
english: As European football leagues prepare for the new season, focus is shifting toward the key players expected to drive their teams to success. Star performers like Arsenal's Declan Rice and Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes remain central to their clubs' strategies due to their impressive statistical contributions. With a relatively quiet transfer window, these established stars will be crucial in determining whether their teams can compete for titles this year.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ሊጎች ለአዲሱ የውድድር ዘመን ሲዘጋጁ፣ ትኩረቱ በቡድኖቻቸው ስኬት ላይ ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖራቸዋል ተብሎ በሚጠበቁ ተጫዋቾች ላይ አርፏል። እንደ አርሰናሉ ዴክላን ራይስ እና የማንችስተር ዩናይትዱ ብሩኖ ፈርናንዴዝ ያሉ ኮከብ ተጫዋቾች ባሳዩት አስደናቂ ብቃት ለክለቦቻቸው ስልት ማዕከል ሆነው ቀጥለዋል። የዘንድሮው የዝውውር መስኮት በአንፃራዊነት የተረጋጋ በመሆኑ፣ እነዚህ ልምድ ያላቸው ተጫዋቾች ቡድኖቻቸው ለዋንጫ የሚደረገውን ውድድር እንዲያሸንፉ ወሳኝ ይሆናሉ።
oromo: Liigonnii kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa waancaa haaraaf yeroo qophaa'aa jiranitti, xiyyeeffannaan taphatoota gurguddoo garee isaanii milkeessuu danda'an irratti godhameera. Taphatoonni akka Declan Rice kan Arsenal fi Bruno Fernandes kan Manchester United gumaacha isaanii kan lakkoofsaan mirkanaa'e irraa kan ka'e qindoomina garee isaanii keessatti bakka guddaa qabu. Gabaan jijjiirraa taphatootaa yeroo kana tasgabbaa'aa waan ta'eef, taphattoonni beekamoon kun gareen isaanii waancaa akka argatuuf murteessoo dha.

title: Opposition MP hurls eggs at Kosovo Prime Minister
english: During a parliamentary session held to organize Kosovo's government after recent elections, an opposition member attacked acting Prime Minister Albin Kurti by throwing eggs at him. This disruptive incident occurred while lawmakers were attempting to establish the new parliament. The act highlights ongoing political tensions within the country's legislative body.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተደረገው ምርጫ የኮሶቮን መንግስት ለማቋቋም በተካሄደው የፓርላማ ስብሰባ ወቅት፣ አንድ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ አባል ጊዜያዊ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አልቢን ኩርቲ ላይ እንቁላል በመወርወር ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው የፓርላማ አባላት አዲሱን ምክር ቤት ለማዋቀር እየሞከሩ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው። ክስተቱም በሀገሪቱ የህግ አውጭ አካል ውስጥ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Filannoo booda mootummaa Kosovoo hundeessuuf yaalii taasifamaa ture irratti, miseensi mormituu tokko muummicha ministeeraa yeroo Albiin Kurtiirratti hanqaaquu darbatee miidheera. Gochi kun kan raawwatame yeroo miseensonni paarlaamaa mana maree haaraa hundeessuuf yaalaa turanitti. Taateen kunis walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa biyyattii keessa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Iran says US must accept ‘irreversible’ Strait of Hormuz order
english: A spokesperson for the Iranian military has declared that new regulations established by Tehran in the Strait of Hormuz are permanent and will not be changed despite American opposition. The official warned that the United States must comply with these measures or face severe consequences that exceed previous challenges. Iran maintains that its position is final and expects the U.S. to accept the current reality in the region.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለፁት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውስጥ የወጡት አዳዲስ ደንቦች የማይቀለበሱ እና በአሜሪካ ተቃውሞ የማይለወጡ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ይህንን ነባራዊ ሁኔታ መቀበል እንዳለባት ካልሆነ ግን ከባድ ዋጋ እንደምትከፍል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ኢራን አቋሟ የጸና እንደሆነ እና አሜሪካ በክልሉ የተፈጠረውን አዲሱን ሁኔታ እንድትቀበል ትጠይቃለች።
oromo: Dubbi himaan waraana Iraan akka ibsetti, seeronni haaraa qarqara galaana Hormuz keessatti baafaman kan hin jijjiiramne fi mormii Amerikaa irraa dhufeen kan hin dhaabbanne ta'uu beeksisaniiru. Amerikaan haala jiru kana fudhachuu qabdi, yoo ta'uu baate garuu miidhaa kanaan dura isheen keessa dabarsite caalu akka qunnamtu akeekkachiisaniiru. Iraan haalli kun kan murtaa'e ta'uu fi Amerikaan dhugaa jiru kana akka fudhattu irra deebitee hubachiisteetti.

title: UNRWA has been with me since birth, I cannot imagine a future without it
english: For millions of Palestinian refugees, the UNRWA is far more than just a humanitarian organization, as it has provided essential healthcare, education, and legal documentation for generations. The author describes the agency as a central pillar of their identity and survival since birth, noting that it stepped in to assist their family when they were displaced during the 1948 Nakba. Ongoing political efforts to dismantle the agency in Gaza and East Jerusalem are seen as a severe threat to the basic well-being and documented existence of the Palestinian people.
amharic: ለሚሊዮኖች ለሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ስደተኞች፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ኤጀንሲ (UNRWA) ከመደበኛ የሰብአዊ ድርጅት በላይ በመሆኑ ለትውልዶች አስፈላጊ የጤና፣ የትምህርት እና ህጋዊ ሰነዶችን ሲያቀርብ ቆይቷል። ጸሐፊው ድርጅቱ ከተወለዱበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ የማንነታቸው እና የህልውናቸው ዋና መሰረት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ፤ በተለይም በ1948 የነበረው መፈናቀል ሲያጋጥማቸው ቤተሰባቸውን እንደረዳ ያስታውሳሉ። በአሁኑ ወቅት በጋዛ እና በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም ኤጀንሲውን ለማፍረስ የሚደረጉ የፖለቲካ ጥረቶች ለፍልስጤማውያን መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች እና የህጋዊ ማንነት ማረጋገጫዎች ትልቅ ስጋት እንደሆኑ ተመልክቷል።
oromo: Miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman baqattoota Filisxeemii hundaaf, dhaabbanni UNRWA gargaarsa namoomaa qofa osoo hin taane, tajaajila fayyaa, barnoota fi ragaalee seeraa dhaloota gara dhalootaatti kan dhiyeessu dha. Barreessichi akka ibsetti, dhaabbatichi dhaloota isaanii irraa eegalee eenyummaa fi jireenya isaanii keessatti gahee guddaa kan qabu yoo ta'u, bara 1948 erga buqqa'anii booda maatii isaanii akka gargaare eeru. Amma ammaa magaalaa Gaazaa fi Yerusaalem keessatti dhaabbaticha diiguuf yaaliin godhamaa jiru, jireenyaa fi mirga bu'uuraa ummata Filisxeemii irratti balaa cimaa kan uume akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Lebanon ‘detains’ former al-Assad-era general, weighs handing him to Syria
english: Lebanese authorities have arrested a retired Syrian Major-General, Adel Issa, after he visited the Syrian embassy in Beirut for paperwork. The former official, who had been hiding in Lebanon since the collapse of the Assad regime, is now facing potential extradition back to Syria. Lebanese officials are currently awaiting formal documentation from Damascus before deciding whether to hand him over to face accusations related to his past military service.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ባለሥልጣናት የቀድሞውን የሶሪያ ጄኔራል አዴል ኢሳን በቤሩት በሚገኘው የሶሪያ ኤምባሲ ውስጥ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የባሽር አል-አሳድ መንግስት ከወደቀ በኋላ በሊባኖስ ተደብቀው የነበሩት ጄኔራሉ፣ አሁን ወደ ሶሪያ የመመለስ እና በወታደራዊ ተግባራቸው ላይ ክስ የመመስረት እድል አላቸው። የሊባኖስ ባለሥልጣናት ጄኔራሉን ወደ ሶሪያ ለማስረከብ ከመወሰናቸው በፊት ከደማስቆ የሚመጣውን መደበኛ የክስ ፋይል በመጠባበቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humni nageenyaa Libaanos  ജനራል Adel Issa kan jedhaman, ergaa hojii garaa garaatiif gara embasii Sooriyaa kan deemanii booda to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Namni kun mootummaan Bashar al-Assad erga kufee booda Libaanos keessa dhokatanii kan turan yoo ta'u, amma gara biyya isaaniitti deebifamanii himata irratti banamuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Qondaaltoonni Libaanos ragaa fi himata mootummaa Sooriyaa irraa dhufu erga ilaalan booda gara biyya isaaniitti isaan erguu fi dhiisuu isaanii murteessuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: UAE says Iran targeted ADNOC tanker in Strait of Hormuz, no casualties
english: The United Arab Emirates has accused Iran's Revolutionary Guard of using a missile to strike an ADNOC oil tanker as it passed through the Strait of Hormuz. While no casualties were reported in this latest incident, officials condemned the act as illegal and a threat to global energy security. This event marks a continuing pattern of attacks on vessels in the vital shipping lane, which regional leaders are now calling on the international community to address.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስ የአቡ ዳቢ ብሔራዊ የነዳጅ ኩባንያ (ADNOC) ታንከር ሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን እያቋረጠ ሳለ በኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ሚሳይል እንደተመታ አስታውቃለች። በዚህ ጥቃት ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት አልተመዘገበም፣ ሆኖም መንግስት ድርጊቱን ህገወጥ እና ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ስጋት እንደሆነ ገልጾታል። ክስተቱ በስትራቴጂካዊው የባህር መስመር ላይ እየተፈጸሙ ያሉ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች አካል ሲሆን፣ የክልሉ ሀገራት ይህንን ለመከላከል ዓለም አቀፍ ጣልቃ ገብነት እንዲኖር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Emirates Gamtoomani, markaan boba'aa kan Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) ta'e tokko yeroo laga Hormuz qaxxaamuru rukutameera jechuun Iran himateera. Hojiin kun waraana Iran (Revolutionary Guard) kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, lubbuun namootaa akka hin dabre gabaafameera. Mootummoonni naannichaa gocha kana balaaleffachuun, nageenya humna elektirikii addunyaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Dhimmi kun daandii galaanaarratti miidhaa irra deddeebi'ee raawwatamu keessaa kan dhihoo ta'ee fi qaamoleen idil-addunyaas xiyyeeffannoo akka kennaniif gaafatameera.

title: Iraq’s Kurdish region wants to stay out of regional conflicts: PM Barzani
english: Kurdistan Regional Government Prime Minister Masrour Barzani has stated that his region aims to remain neutral amid the ongoing conflict between Iran, the US, and Israel. He condemned the hundreds of missile and drone attacks that have damaged regional infrastructure, emphasizing that these assaults are unjustified. Furthermore, Barzani expressed support for the Iraqi government’s initiative to disarm paramilitary groups and ensure that weaponry remains under exclusive state control.
amharic: የኩርዲስታን ክልላዊ መንግስት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር መስሩር ባርዛኒ በኢራን፣ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት ክልላቸው ገለልተኛ ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል። በክልሉ መሠረተ ልማት ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱትን በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የሮኬት እና ድሮን ጥቃቶች ያወገዙት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ፣ እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ተቀባይነት የሌላቸው መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ የኢራቅ መንግስት ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን ትጥቅ ለማስፈታት እና የጦር መሳሪያዎችን በመንግስት ቁጥጥር ስር ለማድረግ የሚያደርገውን ጥረት እንደሚደግፉ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa mootummaa naannoo Kurdistaan Masruur Baarzaanii, walitti bu'iinsa Iran, Ameerikaa fi Israa'el gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru keessatti naannichi gara tokkoottillee akka hin gore ibsaniiru. Miidhaa bu'uuraalee misoomaa naannichaa irra gahe hordofee haleellaa rookeetii fi dooniiwwan dhibbootaan lakkaa'amanitti ba'uun, haleellaan kun sababa malee kan raawwatame ta'uu dubbataniiru. Kana malees, mootummaan Iraaq garee hidhattootaa hidhannoo hiikkachiisuu fi meeshaaleen waraanaa to'annoo mootummaa qofa jala akka oolan gochuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru akka deggeran ibsaniiru.

title: Turkey and Saudi Arabia's rocky relations: A brief history
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman recently prayed together in Mecca, signaling a significant improvement in their previously strained relations. The two nations, along with Pakistan, have strengthened their ties by signing a historic trilateral defense agreement. This collaboration marks a major shift from their long-standing history of competition and occasional political rifts.
amharic: የቱርኩ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶአን እና የሳዑዲው አልጋ ወራሽ መሐመድ ቢን ሳልማን በቅድስት መካ ከተማ በጋራ በመጸለይ ከዚህ ቀደም የነበረውን ውጥረት የተሞላበት ግንኙነት ማሻሻላቸውን አሳይተዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት ከፓኪስታን ጋር በመሆን ታሪካዊ የሆነ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት በመፈራረም አጋርነታቸውን አጠናክረዋል። ይህ ትብብር በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ለረጅም ጊዜ የነበረውን የፉክክር እና የፖለቲካ አለመግባባት ታሪክ ወደ አዲስ ምዕራፍ የሚቀይር ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Rajab Xayyib Erdogaan fi aangessaan Sa'udii Mohammed bin Salmaan magaalaa Makkaatti waliin kadhachuun hariiroo isaanii kan kanaan dura ture fooyyessuu isaanii agarsiisaniiru. Biyyoonni lamaan kun biyya Paakistaan waliin ta'uun waliigaltee ittisaa seena qabeessa ta'e tokko mallatteessuun hariiroo isaanii cimsuu danda'aniiru. Walta'iinsi kun, biyyoota lamaan gidduutti ganna dheeraaf turee fi dorgommii akkasumas rakkoo siyaasaa keessa ture gara fuulduraatti jijjiiruuf gumaacha.

title: Saudi Arabia and Qatar condemn Iranian attack on UAE tanker
english: Saudi Arabia and Qatar have strongly denounced Iran for attacking an Emirati oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. Both nations labeled the incident a major breach of international law and a direct threat to global maritime security and energy trade. They have demanded that Iran stop these aggressive actions and ensure the waterway remains open for international shipping.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ኳታር በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥ ላይ በኤሚሬቶች የነዳጅ መርከብ ላይ የተፈጸመውን የኢራን ጥቃት አጥብቀው አውግዘዋል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት ይህ ድርጊት የአለም አቀፍ ህግን መጣስ እና ለአለም አቀፍ የንግድ መስመሮች ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ኢራን ጥቃቱን እንድታቆም እና የባህር መንገዱ ለነጻ አሰሳ ክፍት እንዲሆን ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Sa’udii Arabiyaa fi Qatar haleellaa Iraan markaba boba’aa kan Emireetotaa irratti naannoo Hormuzitti raawwatte cimsanii balaaleeffataniiru. Biyyoonni lameen kun gochi kun seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu fi nageenya daldala galaanaa addunyaa irratti balaa kan uumu ta’uu ibsaniiru. Iraan gochaa kana akka dhaabdu fi karaa galaanaa sana addunyaaf banaa akka gootu gaafataniiru.

title: Unknown projectile hits vessel near Oman, UKMTO says
english: A ship traveling near the coast of Oman was hit by an unidentified object, causing a fire on the vessel. The crew managed to put out the blaze and remained unharmed. Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding this security incident.
amharic: በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ የምትጓዝ መርከብ በማይታወቅ ነገር ተመትታ እሳት ተነስቶባት ነበር። የመርከቧ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ማጥፋት የቻሉ ሲሆን ሁሉም በሰላም አምልጠዋል። ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት ክስተቱን አስመልክቶ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Markabni tokko qarqara galaana Omaan biratti argamu mi’a hin beekamneen rukutamee ibidda kaasee ture. Hojjattoonni markabtichaa ibidda sana dhaamsuu danda’aniiru akkasumas hundi isaanii nagaan jiru. Aangeyyonni dhimma kana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Lionel Messi’s father dies aged 68 after a long illness
english: Jorge Messi, the father of legendary footballer Lionel Messi, has passed away at 68 following a prolonged battle with illness. He died at a medical facility in Rosario, Argentina, surrounded by his family. Throughout Lionel's career, Jorge served as a vital mentor and representative, playing a key role in the sports icon's professional and personal journey.
amharic: የታዋቂው እግር ኳስ ተጫዋች ሊዮኔል ሜሲ አባት ጆርጅ ሜሲ በ68 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለዩ። ጆርጅ ሜሲ በህመም ምክንያት በአርጀንቲና ሮሳሪዮ ከተማ በሚገኝ የህክምና ማዕከል ውስጥ ለረጅም ጊዜ ህክምና ሲከታተሉ ቆይተው ነው ህይወታቸው ያለፈው። የሊዮኔል ሜሲ የቅርብ አማካሪ እና ወኪል የነበሩት አባታቸው፣ ለልጃቸው ስኬታማ የሙያ ጉዞ ትልቅ ድጋፍ ሲያደርጉ ነበር።
oromo: Abbaan taphataa kubbaa miilaa beekamaa Liyoonel Mesii, Joorgee Mesii, dhukkubsatanii erga tureen booda umurii waggaa 68tti boqotan. Joorgeen magaalaa Roosaariyoo kan argamu hospitaala keessatti maatii isaanii bira jiran. Akka gorsaa fi bakka bu'aa cimaatti, abbaan isaanii kun jireenya kubbaa miilaa Liyoonel Mesii keessatti gahee olaanaa qabu turan.

title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 28
english: The conflict involving Iran has reached its 28th day of the second phase, marked by a new defense agreement between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey that faces skepticism from Iranian leaders. Meanwhile, Iran and Oman have established a security framework for the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, clashes between Yemeni government troops and Houthi forces have intensified.
amharic: የኢራን ግጭት ሁለተኛ ምዕራፍ 28ኛው ቀን ላይ ደርሷል። በሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ በፓኪስታን እና በቱርክ መካከል የተደረገው አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት የኢራን ባለስልጣናትን ጥርጣሬ ፈጥሯል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ላይ የደህንነት ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። በየመን የሚገኙ የመንግስት ኃይሎች እና የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል ያለው ግጭትም ተባብሷል።
oromo: Waraanni Iran sadarkaa lammaffaa isaa guyyaa 28ffaa irra ga’eera. Walii galteen ittisaa biyyoota Sa'ud Arabiyaa, Paakistaanii fi Turkii gidduutti taasifame mormii fi shakkii mootummaa Iran biratti kaaseera. Gama biraatiin, Iran fi Omaan galaana Hormuz irratti walii galtee nageenyaa mallatteessaniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, waldhabdeen humnoota mootummaa Yaman fi garee Huutii gidduu jiru hammaachaa dhufeera.

title: FIFA President Gianni Infantino denies claims UEFA paid off alleged lover
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has firmly rejected accusations that UEFA paid a woman to cover up an alleged romantic relationship with him during his time as their general secretary. While UEFA confirmed they made a standard departure payment and covered educational expenses for the female employee, they did not substantiate claims of an affair. This scandal adds to the pressure on Infantino, who is currently facing calls for his resignation from certain football associations following separate controversies over his management of FIFA.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በዩኤፋ ዋና ጸሃፊ በነበሩበት ወቅት ከአንዲት ሴት ሰራተኛ ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው እና ዩኤፋም ጉዳዩን ለመሸፈን ክፍያ እንደፈጸመ የቀረበባቸውን ክስ አጥብቀው አስተባብለዋል። ዩኤፋ ለሰራተኛዋ የሥራ መልቀቂያ ክፍያ እና የትምህርት ወጪ መሸፈኑን ቢገልጽም፣ የፍቅር ግንኙነት እንደነበረ የሚገልጸውን ክስ ግን አላረጋገጠም። ይህ ክስተት ኢንፋንቲኖ በፊፋ አስተዳደር ላይ በሚያደርጉት ውሳኔዎች ሳቢያ በበርካታ እግር ኳስ ማህበራት ግፊት ውስጥ ባሉበት ወቅት የተከሰተ ተጨማሪ ውዝግብ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantichi FIFA Gianni Infantino, yeroo barreessaa olaanaa UEFA turanitti dubartii tokko waliin hariiroo jaalalaa qabaachuu fi UEFA kana dhoksuuf kaffaltii godheera jedhamee kan irratti dhiyaate himaticha cimsanii haalan. UEFA kaffaltii hojii gadi lakkisuu fi gatii barnootaatiif kaffaluu isaa kan mirkaneesse ta'us, hariiroo jaalalaa jedhame sanarratti garuu waanti ibsame hin jiru. Himatichi kun, Infraantino dhimmoota biroo FIFA keessatti gaggeessan irratti qeeqamanii fi dhiibbaan hojii gadhiisuu irratti mudachaa jiru keessatti kan dabalame dha.

title: Iran deliberates Hormuz arrangement amid uncertain prospects with US
english: Iran and Oman have reached a near-final agreement on maritime routes through the Strait of Hormuz. However, Iranian officials emphasize that the full reopening of this strategic waterway remains conditional on the United States fulfilling prior commitments. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps insists that control of the strait is a matter of national power and has warned the US against interfering in these regional negotiations.

Raayyaan Ittisa Biyyaa Iiraan (IRGC) to'annoon handhuurichaa humna biyyoolessaa kan ibsu ta'uu fi Ameerikaan marii Iiraanii fi Oomaan gidduutti godhamu keessa akka hin galle akeekkachiiseera.

title: Netanyahu mulls Saudi, Turkiye, Pakistan pact as Israeli elections loom
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed the Mecca Joint Defence Pact, establishing a military alliance where an attack on one member is considered an attack on all. This development presents a significant challenge to Israel, which is currently weighing its response while approaching upcoming elections. The agreement brings together three major regional powers, complicating Israel's security outlook and regional diplomatic goals.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈራረሙት አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት፣ በአንዱ አባል ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ እንዲቆጠር የሚያስገድድ ነው። ይህ ህብረት እስራኤልን በክልሉ ባላት ተጽዕኖ ላይ ተግዳሮት የደቀነ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትም ከምርጫ በፊት ለዚህ አዲስ የኃይል ሚዛን እንዴት ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ በማጤን ላይ ይገኛል። ስምምነቱ በእስራኤል የደህንነት እቅድ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ የሚያመጣ ነው ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkiin fi Paakistaan walii galtee ittisa biyyaa 'Mecca' jedhamu kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, kunis tokko irratti haleellaan yoo raawwatame sadanuu akka haleelamanii fudhatamu ibsa. Walii galteen kun biyyoota sadan kana gidduutti guddina waraanaa uumuun isaa, Israa'el yaaddoo keessa kan galche yoo ta'u, mootummaan ishees filannoo dhufu dura tarkaanfii fudhatamu irratti mari'achaa jira. Dhimmi kun hariiroo fi nageenya naannoo sanaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa kan qabu dha.

title: Malaysia seizes container suspected of carrying goods bound for Israel
english: Malaysian authorities recently seized a container at the Port of Tanjung Pelepas due to suspicions that its contents were destined for Israel in violation of national trade laws. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim supported the move, stating that Malaysia will not permit its territory to be used for trade that supports Israel. Officials are currently investigating the shipment to determine if it contains restricted strategic goods, reinforcing the country's commitment to international obligations regarding the Palestinian territories.
amharic: የማሌዥያ ባለሥልጣናት ወደ እስራኤል ሊላኩ የነበሩ ዕቃዎችን የያዘ ኮንቴይነር በታንጁንግ ፔሌፓስ ወደብ መያዛቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሀገሪቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዋር ኢብራሂም እርምጃው ማሌዥያ እስራኤልን የሚደግፍ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ማዕከል እንዳትሆን ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት ያሳያል ብለዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ጭነቱ የሀገሪቱን የንግድ ህግ የሚጥስ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ይህ እርምጃ በፍልስጤም ግዛት ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት ለመቃወም ከታለሙ ዓለም አቀፍ ግዴታዎች ጋር የሚጣጣም ነው።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Maleeshiyaa koonteenara gara Israa'elitti ergamuuf ture tokko buufata doonii Taanjung Peleepaasitti to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Muummeen Ministiraa Anwaar Ibraahiim, Maleeshiyaan daldala Israa'eliin deeggaruufi biyyattii akka daandii darbiinsaatti fayyadamuu akka hin hayyamne ibsaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa qabeenyichi seera daldalaa biyyattii kan cabsu ta'uu fi dhibdee uumamee jiru qulqulleeffachuuf qorannoo geggeessaa jiran; tarkaanfiin kunis dirqama idil-addunyaa kan falmii mirga Falasxiin deeggaruuf fudhatameedha.

title: What Pakistan's defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey means for the Middle East
english: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey have signed the 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement,' a new security pact where an attack on one nation is considered an attack on all three. This alliance represents a significant strategic shift, as these powerful nations aim to secure their own interests amid rising instability and conflict in the Middle East. By combining their military and economic strengths, the three countries hope to protect key shipping routes and reduce their reliance on traditional Western security arrangements.
amharic: ፓኪስታን፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ቱርክ 'የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት' የተሰኘ አዲስ የፀጥታ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል የሚል አንቀጽ አለው። በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ባለው አለመረጋጋት እና ግጭት ሳቢያ እነዚህ ኃያል አገራት የራሳቸውን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ እና የባህር ንግድ መስመሮችን ለመከላከል ተባብረው ለመስራት ወስነዋል።
oromo: Paakistaan, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Turkiin waliigaltee nageenyaa 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement' jedhamu kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa tokko irratti miidhaan yoo ga'e akka sadiin irrattis ga'etti fudhatama. waliigalteen kun biyyoonni kunneen giddugaleessa bahaatti rakkoolee fi walitti bu'iinsa uumameef deebii kennuufi nageenya isaanii ofiin eeggachuuf kan qopha'e dha. Guddina diinagdee fi humna waraanaa walitti fiduun, biyyoonni kunneen karaa bishaan irraa fi faayidaa biyyoolessaa isaanii eeggachuu barbaadu.

title: US pledges $1bn support to Colombia as Trump-backed president sworn in
english: The United States has committed $1 billion in security aid to Colombia following the inauguration of President Abelardo de la Espriella. A close ally of Donald Trump, the new leader has vowed to launch an aggressive crackdown on organized crime and drug trafficking rather than pursuing peace negotiations. This shift marks a major rightward turn for the country as the new administration seeks to strengthen military ties with the U.S. and Israel.

oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa pirezidaantii Kolombiyaa haaraa Abelardo de la Espriella aangoo qabachuu hordofee gargaarsa nageenyaa biiliyoona tokko kan ta'u kennuuf waadaa galeera. Michuu Donald Traamp kan ta'an pirezidaantiin haaraan kun garee yakka raawwatan irratti duula cimaa geggeessuuf karoorfataniiru. Jijjiirraan kun Kolombiyaan gara mirgaatti akka garagalte kan argisiisu yoo ta'u, mootummaan haaraan kun Ameerikaa fi Israa'el wajjin hariiroo waraanaa cimsuuf fedhii qaba.

title: Ivory Coast’s ‘talking drum’ returns to home village after 110 years
english: A sacred musical instrument known as the Djidji Ayokwe has finally returned to its native Ebrie community in Ivory Coast. The drum, which was historically used to communicate important messages and warnings, had been seized by French soldiers over a century ago in 1916. The French government officially handed the artifact back to the village this past February.
amharic: ጂጂ አዮክዌ የሚባል ቅዱስ ከበሮ ከ110 ዓመታት በኋላ ወደ መጣበት የኮትዲቯር የኤብሪ ማህበረሰብ ተመልሷል። ይህ ከበሮ በታሪክ ዘመናት ውስጥ መልዕክቶችን ለማስተላለፍ እና ስለ አደጋዎች ለማስጠንቀቅ ያገለግል የነበረ ሲሆን፣ በ1916 በፈረንሳይ ወታደሮች ተዘርፎ ተወስዶ ነበር። የፈረንሳይ መንግስት ቅርሱኑን በይፋ ለተወላጅ መንደሩ ባለፈው የካቲት ወር አስረክቧል።
oromo: Meeshaan muuziqaa qulqulluun Djidji Ayokwe jedhamu waggoota 110 booda gara biyya isaatti, aanaa ummata Ebrie kan Kootdivuwaaritti deebi'eera. Kunuun kun yeroo darbe ergaa dabarsuufi balaa akeekkachiisuuf gargaaraa ture, bara 1916 waraana Faransaayitti saamamee ture. Mootummaan Faransaay meeshaa kana baatii Guraandhala darbe keessa seeraan gara ganda isaatti deebiseera.

title: Drones spotted in Bulgaria and Germany raise concerns of Russian escalation
english: Recent sightings of unidentified drones near critical infrastructure in Bulgaria and military sites in Germany have sparked alarm across Europe. These incidents, including an explosion near a Bulgarian gas pipeline and unauthorized flights over German defense facilities, have fueled suspicions of Russian interference. As a result, NATO nations are increasingly concerned that the ongoing conflict in Ukraine could expand beyond its borders, prompting urgent discussions regarding national security preparedness.

oromo: Bulgariyaa fi Jarmanii keessatti bakkeewwan tarsiimoo fi buufata waraanaa biratti dooniiwwan eenyummaansaanii hin beekamne mul'achuunsaanii Awurooppaa keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera. title: Police bodycam and CCTV catches Idaho mall shooting as it unfolds
english: Newly released video footage from police cameras and security systems has captured a tragic shooting event at an Idaho shopping center. During the incident, a gunman killed three people and wounded several others. The situation ended when the suspect took his own life.
amharic: በአይዳሆ በሚገኝ የገበያ ማዕከል የተፈጸመውን የተኩስ እልቂት የሚያሳይ የፖሊስ ካሜራ እና የሲሲቲቪ ምስል በይፋ ተለቋል። በዚህ አሰቃቂ ድርጊት ጥቃት አድራሹ ሶስት ሰዎችን ሲገድል ሌሎች በርካቶችን ደግሞ አቁስሏል። ጥቃት አድራሹ በራሱ ላይ ጥይት ተኩሶ ህይወቱ አልፏል።
oromo: Suuraa kaameroota poolisii fi kan naga eegdotaa kanneen bakka gabaa Ayidaaho keessatti dhukaasa cimaa raawwatame mul’isan ifoomee jira. Mudannoo kana keessatti namni miila qajeelaa hin qabne tokko namoota sadii yoo ajjeesu, warra biroo hedduus miidheera. Namichi shakkamaa ta’e kun dhukaasa ofii isaatti dhukaasuun lubbuu isaa galaafateera.

title: Atletico Madrid will not sell Alvarez amid Barcelona interest, says Simeone
english: Atletico Madrid manager Diego Simeone has firmly stated that the club has no intention of selling forward Julian Alvarez, despite strong interest from Barcelona and other major European clubs. The club has even filed a complaint with FIFA over Barcelona's pursuit, emphasizing that Alvarez remains a vital part of their future plans. Simeone expressed his desire to support the player's continued development at the team, dismissing any possibility of a transfer regardless of the price offered.
amharic: የአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ አሰልጣኝ ዲዬጎ ሲሜኦኔ፣ ባርሴሎናን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ክለቦች ለጁሊያን አልቫሬዝ ፍላጎት ቢያሳዩም ተጫዋቹን የመሸጥ ፍላጎት እንደሌላቸው በግልፅ ተናግረዋል። አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ ባርሴሎና ተጫዋቹን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ለማባበል ሞክሯል በሚል ለፊፋ ቅሬታ ማቅረቡም ይታወሳል። ሲሜኦኔ አልቫሬዝ በክለቡ እቅድ ውስጥ ቁልፍ ሚና እንዳለው ገልጸው፣ ምንም አይነት የገንዘብ ጥያቄ ቢቀርብ ተጫዋቹን ላለመልቀቅ መወሰናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Atleetikoo Maadriid Diyegoo Simeeonee, kilabichi taphataa fuula duraa Juuliyaan Alvaareez gurguruuf karoorri tokkollee akka hin jirre ibsaniiru. Giddu galeessa kana keessa baarseenloonafi kilaboonni gurguddoon biroo taphaticha barbaadaa kan jiran ta'us, Atleetikoon garuu gama isaatiin baarseenloon karaa seeraan alaa taphaticha harkisuuf yaalte jechuun FIFA'tti komii dhiyeesseera. Simeeoneen Alvaareez guddina kilabichaaf baay'ee barbaachisaa ta'uu himuun, gatii meeqaatu dhiyaate iyyuu taphaticha gurguruuf fedhii akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru.

title: Arsenal complete signing of Newcastle midfielder Bruno Guimaraes
english: Arsenal has officially acquired Brazilian midfielder Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United for approximately $101 million. The 28-year-old signed a four-year contract with an optional extension, bringing his versatile skills to the reigning Premier League champions. This major transfer is expected to bolster Mikel Arteta's squad as they look to defend their domestic title and succeed in European competitions.
amharic: አርሰናል የብራዚላዊውን አማካይ ብሩኖ ጊማሬስን ከኒውካስትል ዩናይትድ በ101 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ግምት ዋጋ በይፋ አስፈርሟል። የ28 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች ለአራት ዓመታት የሚቆይ ኮንትራት የተፈራረመ ሲሆን፣ በቡድኑ ውስጥ ባለው ብቃት አርሰናል የሊጉን ዋንጫ ለመከላከል እና በአውሮፓ ውድድሮች ውጤታማ ለመሆን ጠንካራ አቅም እንደሚፈጥርለት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Arsenal taphattoolee giddu galeessa biyya Brazil Bruno Guimaraes qulqulleeffannoo Niwukaastil Yuunaytid irraa doolaara miiliyoona 101tti gurguratee bituun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Umuriin isaa waggaa 28 kan ta'e taphattoon kun waliigaltee waggaa afurii kan mallatteesse yoo ta'u, qophii Arsenaal kan ta'e Mikel Arteta garee isaa cimsuuf fi waancaa Premier League itti fufsiisuuf gargaara jedhamee eegama.

title: ‘Hi friends’: Modi’s curious campaign to win over Gen Z
english: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his political party are launching a new social media initiative targeting younger voters. By sharing casual content on Instagram, they hope to improve their image among Gen Z following recent public protests. This strategy reflects an effort to connect with the younger generation through modern digital platforms.
amharic: የህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ እና የፖለቲካ ፓርቲያቸው ወጣት መራጮችን ለመሳብ አዲስ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ዘመቻ ጀምረዋል። በቅርቡ በተደረጉ ተቃውሞዎች ሳቢያ የወጣቶች ተቀባይነት ለመጨመር በኢንስታግራም አማካኝነት መደበኛ ያልሆኑ ይዘቶችን እየለቀቁ ነው። ይህ አካሄድ ወጣቱ ትውልድ ጋር በዲጂታል መድረኮች ለመቀራረብ የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Indiyaa Naarendiraa Moodii fi paartiin isaanii dargaggoota mormataa ofitti harkisuuf sochii midiyaa hawaasummaa haaraa eegalaniiru. Mormiiwwan darban booda amantii dargaggootaa deebifachuuf, Instagram irratti qabiyyee salphaa fi waliin ta'uu agarsiisu maxxansaa jiru. Adeemsi kun dargaggoota biratti fudhatama argachuuf mala dijitaalaa fayyadamuu akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: The post-American Middle East is beginning to take shape
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed a landmark mutual defense pact, signaling a shift toward a new security architecture in the Middle East independent of U.S. influence. This alliance unites three of the most influential Sunni Muslim nations, pledging that an attack on one is considered an attack on all. The agreement follows the recent US-Iran conflict, which highlighted the limitations of the existing American military presence in the region. Regional powers are now taking proactive steps to manage their own collective security as American strategic dominance wanes.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን የአሜሪካን ተጽዕኖ ያልተከተለ አዲስ የክልሉ የጸጥታ ማዕቀፍ ለመመስረት የሚያስችል የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በሶስቱ ሀገራት መካከል የሚፈጸም ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል የሚል ጠንካራ የጋራ መከላከያ ግዴታን ይዟል። በቅርቡ የተካሄደው የአሜሪካ እና ኢራን ግጭት የአሜሪካን የጸጥታ ዋስትና ውስንነት በማሳየቱ፣ የክልሉ ሀገራት የራሳቸውን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ ወደዚህ አዲስ የትብብር እርምጃ እንዲገቡ አስገድዷቸዋል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkii fi Paakistaan harka Amarkaa irraa bilisa ta'eefi nageenya naannichaa eeggachuuf waligaltee ittisa waloo mallatteessaniiru. Waligalteen kun biyyoonni kunneen sadan yoo tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatame, kan biroos haleellaa sana akka ofii isaaniitti akka fudhatan dirqama galchuun kan hundaa'e dha. Waraanni Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti dhiheenya kana tureef, humnoonni naannichaa ga'umsa Ameerikaan naannichatti qabdu kan daangaa qabu ta'uu hubachuun, nageenya isaanii ofumaan eeggachuuf tarkaanfii kana fudhataniiru.

title: Families retrieve bodies after deadly shooting rampage outside Bangkok
english: Families have begun collecting the bodies of loved ones following a tragic shooting at a Thai school that left nine people dead, including a 14-year-old gunman who also killed his grandparents. The incident, which occurred near Bangkok, has left sixteen others injured, many of whom are young students currently in critical condition. Authorities are investigating the attack, noting that the weapon used in the rampage was legally registered to the teenager's grandfather.
amharic: ባንኮክ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጸመ አሰቃቂ የተኩስ አደጋ ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ዘጠኝ ሰዎችን አስከሬን ቤተሰቦቻቸው ተረክበዋል። አጥቂው የ14 ዓመት ታዳጊ ሲሆን አያቶቹን ከገደለ በኋላ በትምህርት ቤቱ መምህራን ላይ ተኩሶ በራሱ ህይወት ላይም አጥፍቷል። በአደጋው 16 ሰዎች ቆስለው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ሲሆን፣ ከጉዳዩ ጋር በተያያዘም ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Maatiin namoota miidhaan irra gahe du'a isaanii booda reeffa isaanii fudhachuu jalqabaniiru. Magaalaa Baangkoookitti dargaggeessi waggaa 14 tokko akaakayyuu fi ayyoyyuu isaa erga ajjeese booda mana barnootaatti dhukaasa banuun namoota sagal ajjeeseera. Miidhaan kun namoota biroo 16 irratti gahee kan jiru yoo ta'u, isaan keessaas hedduun isaanii haala baay'ee yaaddessaa keessa jiru.

title: Woman screams for her man as Ukraine war recruiters pounce
english: A viral video from Ukraine shows men being forcibly detained and pushed into a van by military recruiters, a practice often referred to as 'busification.' This aggressive method of conscription has raised significant concerns about human rights and the state's tactics for gathering soldiers. The incident highlights the growing tensions and controversies surrounding military mobilization efforts in the country.
amharic: ዩክሬን ውስጥ ወታደራዊ ምልመላ የሚያካሂዱ ሰዎች ወንዶችን በኃይል ወደ ሚኒባስ ሲያስገቡ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በስፋት እየተሰራጨ ነው። 'ቡሲፊኬሽን' ተብሎ የሚጠራው ይህ አወዛጋቢ የግዳጅ ምልመላ ስልት፣ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለውን የሰዎች መብት ጥሰት ስጋት ቀስቅሷል። ይህ ክስተት በዩክሬን የጦር ሰራዊት ለመቀላቀል በሚደረገው ጥረት ዙሪያ ያለውን ውጥረት እና ተቃውሞ አመላካች ሆኗል።
oromo: Viidiyoon Yuukireen keessatti namoonni humnaan gara konkolaataa fe'umsaatti butamanii waraanaaf fudhatamaa jiran mul'isu, yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira. 'Busification' jedhamee kan beekamu malli gudeedaan waraana ittiin namoota funaanan kun, mirga namoomaa fi adeemsa mootummaan waraana ittiin gurmeessu irratti gaaffii cimaa kaasee jira. Ta’een kunis sochii waraana Yuukireen keessatti mul’atu irratti mormii fi yaaddoo uumame agarsiisa.

title: Yemen’s collapsing healthcare forces the sick to seek alternative medicines
english: Due to a severe healthcare crisis caused by years of conflict, many people in Yemen are unable to access proper medical treatment and are turning to traditional herbal remedies. This shift often leads to dangerous consequences, as seen with patients who abandon professional medical care for unproven mixtures. Unfortunately, replacing clinical treatments with herbal substitutes frequently results in worsening health conditions and missed opportunities for recovery.
amharic: በየመን ለዓመታት በዘለቀው ግጭት የተነሳ የጤና አገልግሎት በመውደሙ ብዙ ሰዎች ህክምና ማግኘት ተስኗቸው ወደ ባህላዊ ህክምና እየዞሩ ይገኛሉ። እንደነዚህ ያሉ ያልተረጋገጡ የባህል መድኃኒቶች መጠቀም ለታካሚዎች የጤና መታወክ እና ለከፋ ህመም እየዳረጋቸው ነው። ህመምተኞች ዋናውን የህክምና እርዳታ ትተው ወደ እነዚህ አማራጭ ህክምናዎች መሸጋገራቸው አደገኛ የጤና ቀውስ እየፈጠረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraana waggoota hedduuf tureen wal qabatee tajaajilli fayyaa waan hir'ateef, namoonni hedduu yaala ammayyaa argachuu dadhabanii gara qorichaa aadaatti goraa jiru. Qorichoonni aadaa mirkanaa'oo hin taane kun fayyaa namoota irratti miidhaa hamaa geessisaa jira. Dhukkubsattoonni yaala hospitaalaa dhiisanii gara qoricha aadaatti jijjiirachuun isaanii dhibee isaanii daran akka hammaatuufi carraa fayyinaa akka dhaban taasisaa jira.

title: 'Foreign forces must leave': Iran says regional countries can ensure their own security
english: A senior adviser to Iran's supreme leader has demanded the withdrawal of all foreign troops from the region, labeling them as the primary cause of instability. He argued that Middle Eastern nations are capable of maintaining their own security through increased cooperation. Furthermore, he claimed that recent setbacks for American and Israeli interests have strengthened the necessity for these external forces to leave.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ መሪ አማካሪ በክልሉ ውስጥ የሚገኙ የውጭ ኃይሎች ለጸጥታ መደፍረስ ዋና ምክንያት በመሆናቸው በአስቸኳይ መውጣት እንዳለባቸው አስታውቀዋል። የክልሉ አገራት በጋራ በመስራት የራሳቸውን ሰላም ማስጠበቅ እንደሚችሉ የገለጹት አማካሪው፣ የአሜሪካ እና የእስራኤል ተፅዕኖ መቀነስ የውጭ ጦር መውጣትን አስፈላጊነት እንደሚያጎላ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Gorsaan hoogganaa olaanaa Iraan, humnoota alaa naannichaa keessa jiran nageenya booressuun itti gaafatamtoota waan ta'aniif hatattamaan bahuu qabu jedhaniiru. Biyyoonni naannichaa walta'iinsa isaanii cimsuudhaan nageenya isaanii ofiin eeggachuu akka danda'an gorsichi ibsaniiru. Kana malees, dadhabina Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irratti mul'ateen walqabatee, humnoonni alaa naannicha gadhiisuun murteessaa ta'uu isaa hubachiisaniiru.

title: IRGC says Hormuz reopening depends on US accepting Iran’s terms
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps has stated that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the United States agrees to Iran's specific demands. Officials emphasized that this maritime route is a vital element of Iran's national power and security strategy. The government clarified that this issue is independent of any diplomatic negotiations currently taking place with Oman.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይል የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት እንደገና የሚከፈተው አሜሪካ የኢራንን ሁኔታዎች ስትቀበል ብቻ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ እንደገለፁት ይህ የባህር መስመር የኢራን ስትራቴጂያዊ ኃይል አካል በመሆኑ የከፈተው በልዩ ሁኔታዎች መሠረት ብቻ ነው። ጉዳዩ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከኦማን ጋር እየተካሄደ ካለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች ጋር እንደማይገናኝም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Waraana Iran (IRGC) akka ibsanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz kan banamu yoo Ameerikaan gaaffiiwwan Iran fudhatte qofa dha. Aangeyyoonni kun daandiin galaana kun humnaa fi nageenya biyyattii keessatti gahee olaanaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Dhimmi kun marii diippiloomaasii biyyattii Omaan waliin geggeessitu irraa bilisa ta'uu isaas ibsichi ni agarsiisa.

title: 'Used as human bait': Leaked image shows elderly Palestinian men before execution by Israeli forces
english: A recently leaked photograph depicts two elderly Palestinian men, Nadi and Ali Marouf, blindfolded and standing near Israeli soldiers shortly before they were killed in November 2024. Reports indicate that these men were abducted from Beit Lahia and forced to act as human shields by the Israeli military for several days. These allegations of civilians being coerced into dangerous military operations have sparked widespread concern and are classified as violations of international law.
amharic: በቅርቡ የወጣ አንድ ምስል ናዲ እና አሊ ማሩፍ የተባሉ ሁለት አረጋውያን ፍልስጤማውያን በኖቬምበር 2024 ከመገደላቸው ጥቂት ሰዓታት በፊት በዓይናቸው ታፍነው በእስራኤል ወታደሮች መካከል ቆመው ያሳያል። ዘገባዎች እንደሚጠቁሙት እነዚህ ሰዎች ከቤት ላሂያ የተወሰዱ ሲሆን ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ለበርካታ ቀናት የሰው ጋሻ ሆነው እንዲያገለግሉ ተደርገዋል። ንጹሃን ዜጎችን አስገድዶ ወደ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ውስጥ ማስገባት ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ እና ከፍተኛ ቁጣን የቀሰቀሰ ድርጊት ነው።
oromo: Suurri dhiheenya kana bahe tokko, namootni umriin isaanii deemaa ta'e Nadii fi Alii Ma'ruuf jedhaman, Sadaasa 2024 keessa ajjeefamuu isaanii dura ijaan hidhamanii waraana Israa'el biratti mul'achuu isaanii argisiisa. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, namootni kunneen Beit Laahiyaa irraa butamanii guyyoota muraasaaf akka gaachana namootatti fayyadamaa turaniiru. Namoota nagaa dirqisiisanii hojii waraanaafi fayyadamuu fi balaa keessa buusuun kun seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu ta'uun isaatiin mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Israel has the power to dominate, but not to lead the region
english: Israel possesses significant military might that allows it to exert force and control over its neighbors, but it lacks the political and social influence to achieve true regional leadership. While its technology sector is highly successful, it remains heavily integrated into and dependent on the American system rather than creating independent global authority. Ultimately, Israel's reliance on coercion means it can destroy threats, but it fails to build the consensus or regional integration necessary to lead.
amharic: እስራኤል በወታደራዊ አቅሟ በጎረቤት ሀገራት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ መፍጠር ብትችልም፣ የክልሉን አመራር ለመያዝ የሚያስችል ፖለቲካዊ እና ማህበራዊ ተቀባይነት የላትም። የቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፏ እጅግ የዳበረ ቢሆንም፣ ከራሷ ገለልተኛ በሆነ መንገድ ዓለም አቀፍ ተጽዕኖ ከመፍጠር ይልቅ በአሜሪካ ስርዓት ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው። በመሆኑም እስራኤል በጉልበት ትችላለች እንጂ በስምምነት እና በመረዳዳት የክልሉን አገራት መምራት አልቻለችም።
oromo: Israa'el humna waraanaa cimaa qabaachuun biyyoota ollaa ishee irratti dhiibbaa gochuu dandeessi, garuu gaggeessituu naannawaa ta'uuf hayyamaa fi fudhatama siyaasaa hin qabdu. Dameen teeknoolojii ishee milkaa'ina guddaa kan qabu ta'us, akka waan of danda'etti addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu mannaa, guddina ishee guutumatti sirna Ameerikaa irratti hundaa'eera. Walumaagalatti, Israa'el humnaan dirqisiisuu dandeessi malee, waliigaltee fi wal-hubannoon naannicha hoogganuuf hamma ammaatti hin milkoofne.

title: How Israel’s occupation fuels resistance
english: The ongoing Israeli occupation of Palestinian territories is trapped in a dangerous cycle where military control triggers local resistance, which then serves as a pretext for further expansion. A recent escalation near Nablus resulted in the death of five Palestinians following the establishment of four additional illegal outposts. This persistent pattern of violence and settlement expansion continues to destabilize the region.
amharic: በፍልስጤም ግዛቶች ላይ ያለው የእስራኤል ወረራ ወታደራዊ ቁጥጥር ለአካባቢው ተቃውሞ መነሳሳት እንደሚሆን እና ይህም ለበለጠ ወረራ ምክንያት እንደሚሆን በሚያሳይ አደገኛ ዑደት ውስጥ ወድቋል። በናብለስ አቅራቢያ አራት አዳዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎች ከተቋቋሙ በኋላ በተነሳ ግጭት አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው የጥቃት እና የሰፈራ መስፋፋት አካባቢውን ወደለላ ቀውስ እያመራው ይገኛል።
oromo: Qabsoon Israa'el naannolee Falasxiin irratti gootu, to’annoon waraanaa mormii akka kaasu fi mormiin sun immoo sababa biraa ta’ee babal’ina lafaa akka babal’isuu godha. Nablus biratti buufataalee haarawa afur erga dhaabamanii booda, walitti buiinsa uumameen Falasxiinonni shan ajjeefamaniiru. Gochi kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi babal'ina buufataalee waraanaa itti fufiinsaan kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Todd Blanche, Trump's ex-lawyer, confirmed as US attorney general
english: Todd Blanche, formerly Donald Trump’s private attorney, has been officially confirmed as the United States Attorney General following a narrow 50-49 Senate vote. His nomination faced significant opposition from Democrats and some Republicans who expressed concerns regarding his past professional conduct and potential for politicizing the Justice Department. Despite these controversies, Senator Bill Cassidy provided the final supporting vote, allowing Blanche to take over the role permanently after serving as the acting official since April.
amharic: የቀድሞው የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የግል ጠበቃ የነበሩት ቶድ ብላንች፣ በሴኔቱ በተካሄደ ጠባብ ድምፅ በ50 ለ49 የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ዓቃቤ ህግ ሆነው ተሾሙ። ለእጩነታቸው በዴሞክራቶች እና በአንዳንድ ሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ዘንድ ከባድ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸው ነበር፤ ይህም በዋናነት ያለፈውን የስራ ታሪካቸውን እና የፍትህ ሚኒስቴርን ወደ ፖለቲካ የመቀየር አቅም ስላለው ስጋት ነው። እነዚህ አለመግባባቶች ቢኖሩም፣ ሴናተር ቢል ካሲዲ ወሳኙን ድምፅ በመስጠታቸው፣ ብላንች ከሚያዝያ ወር ጀምሮ ሲመሩት የነበረውን ጊዜያዊ ስራ በቋሚነት እንዲረከቡ አስችሏቸዋል።
oromo: Ogeessi seeraa kanaan dura Donald Trump tajaajilaa turan Todd Blanche, sagalee 50 fi 49n Mana Maree Senaatii Ameerikaatiin Abbaa Alangaa Waliigalaa ta'anii mirkanaa'aniiru. Muudamni isaanii gama Paartii Dimokiraataa fi miseensota Senaatii warra Ripabiliikaa muraasaatiin mormii cimaa kan mudate yoo ta'u, kunis hojii isaanii darbee fi waajjira haqaa gara siyaasaatti geessuu danda'u jedhamee sodaatamee ture. Mormiiwwan kun hundi jiraatuyyuu, Senater Biil Kaasidii sagalee murteessaa kennuun isaanii, Blanche ji'a Ebla irraa jalqabee hoogganaa turan sanatti guutumaan guututti akka itti fufan taasiseera.

title: Trump’s former personal lawyer narrowly confirmed as US attorney general
english: The U.S. Senate has narrowly confirmed Todd Blanche, a former personal attorney for President Donald Trump, as the new attorney general. This appointment faced significant criticism due to concerns that Blanche might compromise the Justice Department's historical independence to serve the president’s political agenda. While some Republicans initially questioned his controversial financial and legal actions, Blanche eventually secured approval after promising to revise certain policies.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የቀድሞ የግል ጠበቃ የሆኑትን ቶድ ብላንሽን በአዲሱ የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ዓቃቤ ህግነት በጠባብ ድምፅ አፅድቋል። ብላንች የፍትህ ሚኒስቴርን ገለልተኛነት በመጠበቅ ረገድ ትልቅ ስጋት ይፈጥራሉ በሚል ብዙ ትችቶች ቢሰነዘሩባቸውም፣ የቀረቡላቸውን ተቃውሞዎች በመፍታታቸው ስልጣኑን ተረክበዋል። አንዳንድ የሪፐብሊካን አባላትም የገንዘብ አጠቃቀምን በተመለከተ ስጋት የነበራቸው ቢሆንም፣ የፖሊሲ ማስተካከያ በማድረጋቸው ማፅደቃቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mana maree Ameerikaa (Senate) kan ture Todd Blanche, kan kanaan dura abukaatoo dhuunfaa Donald Trump turan, akka abbaa seeraa guddaa (Attorney General) biyyattii ta'an sagalee muraasaan mirkaneesseera. Muudamni kun, waajjirri haqaa bilisummaa isaa eeggachuu akka hin dandeenyeefi ajandaa siyaasaa dura taa'ichaaf akka hojjetu yaaddoo uumeera. Sagaleen kun mormii hedduu keessa kan darbe yoo ta'u, Blanche hojiiwwan mormii kaasan tokko tokko fooyyessuuf waadaa seenuun isaa muricha akka injifatu isa gargaareera.

title: Fiji rugby player dies in Japan of suspected heatstroke as high of 35C hit
english: A 26-year-old Fijian rugby player named Saimoni Vunilagi has died in Japan following a suspected heatstroke. He fell ill after a team training session in Fukuoka, where temperatures reached 35 degrees Celsius. This tragic incident highlights the growing risks of extreme heat in Japan, which has seen record-breaking temperatures and an increasing number of heat-related hospitalizations recently.
amharic: ሳይሞኒ ቩኒላጊ የተባለ የ26 ዓመት የፊጂ የራግቢ ተጫዋች በጃፓን በሙቀት መጨመር ምክንያት በተጠረጠረ ህመም ህይወቱ አልፏል። ስፖርተኛው በፉኩኦካ ከተማ የአካል ብቃት እንቅስቃሴ ካደረገ በኋላ በከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን ሳቢያ ታሞ ወደ ሆስፒታል ቢወሰድም ሊያገግም አልቻለም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በጃፓን እየተመዘገበ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን እና በሰው ልጆች ጤና ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን አደጋ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Taphatni ragbii biyya Fijii kan umriin isaa 26, Saayimonii Vuunilaagii jedhamu, biyya Jaappaan keessatti dhukkuba kahuu oowwaa (heatstroke) irraan kan ka'e lubbuun isaa darbeera. Ispoorteessichi magaalaa Fuuku'oonaatti leenii booda ho'a guyyaa hanga digirii 35 ga'uun dhukkubsatee hospitaala kan galte ta'us, guyyoota muraasa booda du'aan addunyaa kana irraa boqoteera. Balaan kun yeroo ammaa Jaappaan keessatti ho'a humnaa olii fi balaa inni fayyaa irratti geessisu hubachiisa.
